landing.heroSubtitle: VyomFlow helps you monitor memory, attention, reaction speed, and language patterns over time — for awareness, not diagnosis.
landing.disclaimerAccept: I understand and accept these terms
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Our intelligent system guides you through cognitive assessments and provides meaningful trend analysis.
landing.step1Desc: Take short cognitive tests covering memory, reaction time, pattern recognition, and language.
landing.step2Desc: Your results are stored locally and tracked over multiple sessions to identify patterns.
landing.step3Desc: Our on-device machine learning model analyzes your trends without sending data anywhere.
landing.step4Desc: Receive insights about your cognitive trends to support proactive health awareness.
landing.memoryRecallDesc: Test your working memory by memorizing and recalling word sequences.
landing.reactionTimeDesc: Measure your response speed to visual stimuli with millisecond precision.
landing.patternRecognitionDesc: Challenge your visual processing by identifying patterns in complex grids.
landing.languageTaskDesc: Analyze speech patterns and verbal fluency through voice-based exercises.
landing.privacyFirstDesc: All data stays on your device. No cloud uploads, no tracking.
landing.evidenceBasedDesc: Tests based on established cognitive assessment methodologies.
landing.notDiagnosticDesc: Designed for awareness, not medical diagnosis. Consult professionals for concerns.
landing.footerText: Cognitive performance tracking for awareness, not diagnosis.

tests.visualMemoryDesc: Remember images shown briefly, then identify them from a grid of similar objects.
tests.reactionTimeDesc: Respond as quickly as possible when the screen changes color.
tests.patternRecognitionDesc: Identify the matching or different pattern in a grid.
tests.languageTaskDesc: Describe what you did yesterday using voice input.
tests.sustainedAttentionDesc: Tap green circles and resist tapping red squares in this Go/No-Go test.

disclaimer.main:
This tool is for cognitive performance monitoring only.
It does NOT provide medical diagnosis.
If you have health concerns, please consult a qualified professional.
disclaimer.footer: This tool provides cognitive performance trends and does not constitute medical advice.

demo.title: Cognitive Trend Analysis
demo.viewingDataSuffix: showing a gradual cognitive decline pattern over 6 sessions.
demo.aboutDesc1: This demo shows a simulated cognitive decline pattern. The data represents a user whose memory accuracy drops from 86% to 58% over 5 weeks, with corresponding increases in reaction time variance and decreases in pattern recognition scores.
demo.aboutDesc2: In a real scenario, this pattern would trigger our ML-based anomaly detection and generate a "Possible Cognitive Risk" alert.
